html:
Onlayn Hamshira 2.0: A More Convenient, Modern and Faster App Experience

Onlayn Hamshira Has Been Updated to Version 2.0

Onlayn Hamshira has launched its new 2.0 version, offering a more convenient, modern and user-friendly experience for both patients and medical specialists. The main goal of this update is to simplify the process of requesting medical services at home or at a convenient location, reduce the time needed to place an order and make the app easier to use for everyone.

With the updated version, users can choose the required medical service faster, place an order for themselves or their loved ones and use additional options when selecting a specialist. For medical specialists, the app interface has also been redesigned and improved with new features that make daily work more convenient.

A Completely Redesigned Modern Interface

In Onlayn Hamshira 2.0, the app design has been significantly updated. The new interface is more modern, simple and easy to understand. Sections, ordering steps and key features have been arranged in a more convenient way so that users can quickly find what they need.

This update makes the app easier to use for both first-time users and regular customers of the platform.

Easier and More Convenient Ordering

The process of placing an order has become simpler and faster in the new version. Users can choose the required medical service, enter the address and request a specialist through a clearer and more convenient interface.

Patients can now select the gender of the specialist. This feature is especially useful for certain medical services where comfort, trust and personal preference are important for the patient.

Users can also place an order not only for themselves, but also for their family members and loved ones. The app now allows users to specify who the service is for, such as “myself”, “father”, “mother”, “sister” and other options. This makes Onlayn Hamshira even more convenient for family use.

Card Payment Option Added

Onlayn Hamshira 2.0 now includes the option to place an order using a bank card. This makes the service experience more convenient and modern.

Users can now request a specialist quickly and complete the payment process in a more comfortable way.

Faster Specialist Matching

In the updated version, the process of finding a specialist after an order is placed has been improved and shortened. This helps reduce waiting time and allows patients to receive the needed medical procedure more quickly.

One of the key priorities of the Onlayn Hamshira team is to make qualified medical support more accessible at the patient’s preferred location.

One-Time 20% Promo Code for First Orders!

To mark the launch of the updated app, a special one-time 20% discount promo code has been introduced for users. Apply it to receive medical services on more favorable terms.

SALOM20

New Features for Medical Specialists

Onlayn Hamshira 2.0 also brings important updates for medical specialists working on the platform. The specialist app interface has been redesigned. Sections are now clearer, and the main work-related features are easier to access and use.

A dark mode has also been added to the app. This is especially useful for specialists who prefer a more comfortable viewing experience, particularly in the evening or low-light conditions.

In addition, users can now adjust the font according to their personal preferences. This makes the app more flexible, accessible and convenient for everyday use.

Karakalpak Language Support Added

Another important update in version 2.0 is the addition of the Karakalpak language. This makes the platform more accessible and convenient for a wider audience.

Users and specialists can now use the app in a language that is more familiar and comfortable for them.

Specialists Can View Ratings and Reviews

A new important feature has also been added for specialists: they can now view the ratings and written reviews left by patients after completed services.

This helps specialists receive direct feedback, better understand patient experience and continue improving the quality of their services.

Onlayn Hamshira 2.0: A New Step Toward More Accessible Medical Care

Version 2.0 is an important step in the development of the Onlayn Hamshira platform. The updated design, simplified ordering process, card payment option, specialist gender selection, ordering for family members, Karakalpak language support, dark mode and access to reviews create a more modern and convenient app experience.

Update or download the Onlayn Hamshira app now and order the medical service you need at your preferred location.
